page.title: Import
page.subtitle: Add or update many records at once from an Excel workbook.
page.notAvailableDescription: Importing is available to district and school administrators only.

templateStep.heading: Download the template
templateStep.intro: Fill in the <sheetName>{{sheet}}</sheetName> sheet — one row per {{noun}}. The <values>Values</values> sheet lists the allowed entries, including your district's schools.
templateStep.studentNote: Rows are matched on StudentId. Blank cells keep the current value; type CLEAR to clear one. Missing rows never exit anyone.
templateStep.downloadError: Could not download the template. Try again.

uploadStep.heading: Upload your workbook
uploadStep.description: .xlsx only, up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows. Formulas and macros are never run.
uploadStep.couldNotRead: The workbook could not be read

previewStep.heading: Preview
previewStep.downloadErrorReportFailed: Could not download the error report
previewStep.errorRowsNotice_one: Error rows are skipped. Fix them in the workbook and upload again, or import the {{count}} valid row now.
previewStep.errorRowsNotice_other: Error rows are skipped. Fix them in the workbook and upload again, or import the {{count}} valid rows now.
previewStep.noDataRows: The workbook has no data rows.
previewStep.commitMessageWithErrors_one: Import {{count}} valid row and skip {{errorCount}} with errors? This writes {{newCount}} new and updates {{updatedCount}}.
previewStep.commitMessageWithErrors_other: Import {{count}} valid rows and skip {{errorCount}} with errors? This writes {{newCount}} new and updates {{updatedCount}}.
previewStep.commitMessage_one: Import {{count}} row? This writes {{newCount}} new and updates {{updatedCount}}.
previewStep.commitMessage_other: Import {{count}} rows? This writes {{newCount}} new and updates {{updatedCount}}.
previewStep.commitFailed: The import could not be committed

history.heading: Previous imports
history.emptyDescription: Committed and previewed workbooks will be listed here.
